- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Indonesian 3D first-person water-rocket game set in a home yard, with a garage workshop, rocket and pump shop, upgrades, launches, and coin rewards.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Buatkan saya game roket air 3d POV dengan sistem, beli roket dan lainnya, peluncuran pompa, menghasilkan uang, dan memodifikasi roket, ada toko jual roket botol air dan jual pompa buat mengisi roketnya, tempat di rumah dengan tempat modifikasi roket digarasi rumah, dan peluncuran dibelakar rumah”.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained Three.js/Vite game with Indonesian UI, browser-saved progression, and procedurally modeled home, yard, launch site, and garage.
- Interpreted “POV” as a first-person navigable scene with keyboard/touch movement and drag-to-look.

## Work State

- Implemented game HUD, yard/garage navigation, missions, coin wallet, pumping, launches, rewards, and progression saved to localStorage.

- Modeled the home, garden, launch site, rocket, pump, and garage workshop in Three.js.
- `npm run build` succeeded before latest unverified changes.
